focus.title: 消息人士称OPEC+原则同意维持12月产量目标
focus.fact: Reuters援引消息人士报道，OPEC+原则同意保持12月石油产量目标不变；Bloomberg随后援引两名代表称，主要成员预计坚持配额不变的计划。截至本次截止，尚未取得OPEC官方会议最终结果。
focus.impact: 若配额维持不变，政策层面不会增加额外供给，但实际产量仍取决于冲突、运输和执行情况。油价与通胀传导应观察真实供应恢复，而不能只看配额措辞；能源成本和长端利率可能共同影响企业利润与资本开支。
focus.counterCase: 正式会议决定不同，或配额未变但实际供给明显恢复，都会改变供应约束判断。
focus.selectionReason: 相较缺少原始来源的融资和芯片数字，此项有可识别媒体原帖及明确政策阶段，影响范围较广。

items.title: Elon Musk披露训练与推理楼配置及投运目标
items.fact: Elon Musk称Macroharder和Minihard各配置22万“GB300s”，用于训练；Gun Range计划采用相同配置，目标11月底投运。Spam计划配置约20万“GB300s”用于推理，目标12月投运，网络更简单、光纤用量不到训练配置的一半。原文未定义该计数单位，也未确认当前已投运总量。
items.whyItMatters: 训练与推理工作负载对网络投入的需求可能不同；若目标兑现，会改变算力和互联设备需求的节奏。这里是管理者披露的配置与未来目标，实际交付、通电和投运仍须分别观察。
items.counterCase: 延期、配置变化或计数口径澄清会改变需求估算；不将相关三帖合计数与年底目标重复相加。
items.author: elonmusk
items.eventTimeNote: 具体事件发生时刻未知，发帖时刻另列。
items.originalText: @herbertong @CernBasher Macroharder and Minihard both have 220k GB300s with 800 gig nics configured for training. Gun Range will have the same. Spam (used to house Hormel products) will have ~200k GB300s, but configured for inference, so much simpler networking and less than half the fiber. I walked the whole Colossus 2 site around midnight and again this morning. Good progress by the SpaceX team and contractors. Gun Range is tracking to be operational by end of November and Spam in December.

items.title: 客户披露GB300训练与推理配置，新增楼目标年底投运
items.fact: Elon Musk称Macroharder和Minihard各配置22万“GB300s”，用于训练；Gun Range计划采用相同配置，目标11月底投运。Spam计划配置约20万“GB300s”用于推理，目标12月投运，网络更简单、光纤用量不到训练配置的一半。原文未定义该计数单位，也未确认当前已投运总量。
items.whyItMatters: 客户本人披露的配置与计划，为NVIDIA需求提供一条具体线索。训练与推理的网络投入不同，设备需求不能仅用计算单元数量推算；收入确认还取决于交付、验收和投运节奏。
items.counterCase: 若建设延期、计数单位发生澄清或交付阶段不同，需求和收入时点均可能变化；不把计划当作已投运，不叠加相关帖的重复计数。
items.author: elonmusk
items.eventTimeNote: 具体事件发生时刻未知，发帖时刻另列。
items.originalText: @herbertong @CernBasher Macroharder and Minihard both have 220k GB300s with 800 gig nics configured for training. Gun Range will have the same. Spam (used to house Hormel products) will have ~200k GB300s, but configured for inference, so much simpler networking and less than half the fiber. I walked the whole Colossus 2 site around midnight and again this morning. Good progress by the SpaceX team and contractors. Gun Range is tracking to be operational by end of November and Spam in December.

        - text: ：HERE'S WHAT THE 🇺🇸 STOCK MARKET LOOKED LIKE THIS WEEK

        - text: ：My $VRT Q3 review is finally done. I went back through my earlier articles to see how the thesis is holding up.

        - text: • What the order growth and backlog tell us about 2027.

        - text: • Whether my EPS estimates still hold up, and what valuation a potential doubling would require.
        - text: More confidence in the business after this quarter, with a few assumptions from my earlier articles that deserved another look.

        - strong: 原文摘录
        - text: "：A good question on my $VRT article: how much of the cash generation comes from the business itself, and how much comes from customers paying ahead of delivery?"
        - text: This is exactly what I wanted to test in my $VRT article.
        - text: For the first nine months, Vertiv generated $2.23bn after capex and capitalized software. Removing the entire $540m net working-capital benefit still leaves roughly $1.69bn.
        - text: That gives me confidence in the business’s ability to fund itself. It isn’t a scenario with all customer advances removed, since those also help finance inventory and receivables, but the cash generation goes well beyond the net working-capital benefit.

items.title: PlanAssist向更多英国地方议会开放
items.fact: Google DeepMind称，基于Gemini的PlanAssist可帮助规划官员评估住户申请，并正向另外12个地方议会开放。公司称所花时间最多可缩短58%；原帖没有给样本、基线、平均值或付费部署阶段。
items.whyItMatters: 这是AI进入政府工作流的一条具体渠道扩展线索。开放范围增加可能带来使用反馈，但尚不能换算为新增收入或平均生产率提升；后续应观察实际采用、人工复核和服务成本。
items.counterCase: 58%是公司报告的上限，不是平均效果；若只是试用或少数任务有效，商业化和整体行政效率的推断会减弱。
items.author: GoogleDeepMind
items.originalText: We built PlanAssist to help UK Government planning officers speed up building and renovations across the country. Built with Gemini, it has shown it can cut the time planning officers spend assessing householder applications by up to 58%. It is now being made available to 12 more councils to help them to make faster decisions.

reviews.title: 营养补充会改变部分乳汁成分，生长改善有情境差异
reviews.originalTitle: Nutritional interventions’ impacts on human milk: Three trials in low-resource settings
reviews.authorsNote: 仅列第一位个人署名作者，非完整名单。
reviews.publicationDateNote: 已核Crossref正式发表日；PubMed标为在线先行。
reviews.stage: 三项随机试验资料整合
reviews.takeaway: 三项试验显示，母亲营养补充可提高乳汁B族维生素；婴儿生长改善只在营养不足更重的队列中观察到。

summary.problem: 母亲营养干预会不会让乳汁各类成分一起改变？
summary.method: 研究整合布基纳法索、巴基斯坦和坦桑尼亚三项随机试验的乳汁资料，比较平衡能量蛋白补充或烟酰胺干预与各自对照，并测量营养成分、菌群及组学指标。
summary.findings: B族维生素升高，宏量营养素、低聚糖等相对受生理缓冲。产后能量蛋白补充只在营养不足更重的队列改善婴儿生长。
summary.statistics: 摘要未报告总样本数和数值效应量，不自行补填。
summary.limitations: 不同干预、营养背景和结果指标不能混为一谈；不能推导所有哺乳者都需自行补充同一种营养品。
summary.meaning: 干预对不同成分及不同人群的作用可能不同。

reviews.title: 接种后发热的差异，与接种前菌群状态有关
reviews.originalTitle: The human gut microbiome primes fever after vaccination
reviews.authorsNote: 仅列第一位个人署名作者，非完整名单。
reviews.publicationDateNote: 已核Crossref正式发表日；PubMed同时确认同日在线发表。
reviews.stage: 人群纵向观察加类器官与小鼠实验
reviews.takeaway: 171名成人的接种后发热风险与接种前肠道炎症和菌群特征相关；实验支持部分机制，但尚非人体饮食干预证据。

summary.problem: 同样接种疫苗，为什么有人更容易发热？
summary.method: 研究纵向测量171名健康成人接种mRNA疫苗前后的粪便菌群、口腔温度和血清指标；另将高风险供者菌群用于人肠道类器官及无菌小鼠实验。
summary.findings: 接种前低度炎症、部分带鞭毛细菌及鞭毛蛋白表达与发热风险相关；供者菌群在实验系统中产生更强炎症，饮食可改变小鼠相关反应。
summary.statistics: 人体样本171人；摘要未给出可用于个人预测的绝对风险或干预效应量。
summary.limitations: 人体饮食为自报关联，小鼠干预不能直接证明人改变饮食就能避免发热，也不支持个人接种决策。
summary.meaning: 人群关联与实验机制证据应分层解读。

reviews.authorsNote: 仅列第一位个人署名作者，非完整名单。
reviews.publicationDateNote: 已核Crossref正式发表日；仅已核印刷日，在线首发日未知。

summary.problem: 鸟鸣与人声的相似性，是否主要来自模仿学习？
summary.method: 研究比较367种鸟的逾7.45万个发声单元、约5900首鸟鸣，以及52种人类语言的逾1.5万个单元；同时比较发声学习类群和近缘非学习类群。
summary.findings: 多种声学模式跨鸟类类群出现，并与人类言语或歌唱相似；是否具有发声学习能力，没有系统改变这些模式和相似度。
summary.statistics: 367种鸟、52种语言；发声单元数量不是独立人类或动物个体数。
summary.limitations: 这是比较语料分析，不能仅由声音相似证明同一认知机制，也不能断言每种鸟都完全不需要学习。
summary.meaning: 表面相似与产生它的机制是两个问题。

professional.definition: 在线性模型Y=α+βX+ε中，若真实解释变量X不可见，只观测到W=X+U，且测量误差U均值为零、与X及ε不相关，X与ε也不相关，则用W做普通最小二乘回归，斜率的大样本极限是β×Var(X)/[Var(X)+Var(U)]，向零衰减。

story.title: 长廊里的布商
story.body:
以下为原创虚构寓言，人物、制度和数字均为教学设定。

河湾城的染坊沿着长廊收布。布匹的真实长度由库房的标准量具确定，染坊按固定的每尺单价付钱。新来的账房不参与计价，只负责在另一本账上记下每匹布有多长、卖了多少钱。

他用的是一把带滑动刻度条的木尺。刻度条每次拿起时会往左或往右窜一点，长短方向都没有固定偏向。账房起初并不在意：今天多记一些，明天少记一些，月底总能抵消。

过了一个季度，他把长度和收入画在纸上，却发现长布未必卖得多，短布未必卖得少。那条表示“多一尺能多赚多少”的线，比库房的固定单价平缓得多。

他怀疑城里的布商暗中压价，便把两百匹的账扩成两千匹。纸上的点密了，线的位置更稳了，线却仍不肯抬起来。布商拿出每张付款单，单价没有变过。

老掌柜没有再翻付款单。他让账房把同一匹布量十遍，十个长度竟散落在账本好几格里；价钱却只有一个。又找来两匹真实长度相近的布，刻度条一滑，其中一匹在账上像是忽然长了一截。

“你把本来差不多的布，分进了很远的格子，”掌柜说，“这些格子拉开了，钱却不会跟着那根刻度条移动。”

账房终于看见，线并非被城里的单价压平。是账本横排里混进了许多并不代表真实布长的变化。他换回标准量具，先核对记录，再重新讨论布和钱的关系。

knowledge.title: 发热差异，可能在接种前已埋下线索
knowledge.intuition: 同种疫苗后的发热差异，只取决于疫苗本身。
knowledge.fact: 171名健康成人研究发现，接种前的肠道炎症与部分菌群特征，和接种后发热风险相关。
knowledge.explanation: 供者菌群在类器官和小鼠实验中也产生较强炎症，提示宿主原有状态可能参与反应。
knowledge.boundary: 人体饮食资料是关联，小鼠饮食实验不能证明人靠改变饮食就能避免发热，也不能据此决定接种。

sources.label: The human gut microbiome primes fever after vaccination

knowledge.title: 声音像，不等于学习方式相同
knowledge.intuition: 鸟鸣像人声，主要因为鸟也学会了模仿。
knowledge.fact: 比较367种鸟和52种人类语言的声学语料后，研究发现多类共有模式并不随发声学习能力系统改变。
knowledge.explanation: 相近的声音结构，可以出现在会与不会发声学习的类群中，表面相似并不足以确定产生机制。
knowledge.boundary: 这是语料比较，不是直接操纵学习的实验，也不是说所有鸟鸣都无需学习。

sources.label: Pervasive patterns in bird songs resemble those in human speech and song and are independent of vocal learning

knowledge.title: 观念短课的效果，也看周围人怎么做
knowledge.intuition: 告诉学生能力可以成长，就能普遍提高成绩。
knowledge.fact: 美国随机试验中，短课改善了低成绩学生的核心课GPA，效果随学校同伴规范变化。
knowledge.explanation: 相信能力可发展，仍需要把尝试与坚持放进有支持的学习环境；同一干预在不同情境中可能表现不同。
knowledge.boundary: 高成绩组核心GPA未显著改善，不能将这套课程直接推广成任何年龄都有效的提分口号。

sources.label: A national experiment reveals where a growth mindset improves achievement

knowledge.title: 社区很团结，未必等于跨阶层联系多
knowledge.intuition: 一个社区人缘好、互相熟，就代表社会资本都高。
knowledge.fact: 分析210亿条好友关系的研究发现，经济联结、社群凝聚和公民参与三类指标并不高度相关。
knowledge.explanation: 熟人之间紧密相连，与不同收入者彼此相连，测量的是不同网络结构，对经济流动的预测也不同。
knowledge.boundary: 研究为观察性分析；地区预测关系不能变成个人交富人朋友就增收的因果承诺。

sources.label: Social capital I: measurement and associations with economic mobility

knowledge.title: 体重上升，农村也是主角
knowledge.intuition: 全球肥胖主要是城市生活越来越普及造成的。
knowledge.fact: 汇总逾1.12亿成人测量的研究发现，1985—2017年全球平均BMI增幅逾55%来自农村BMI上升。
knowledge.explanation: 许多中低收入地区农村BMI追近城市，说明只盯城市会遗漏重要变化，也需关注农村食物环境。
knowledge.boundary: 这是平均BMI增幅分解，不是肥胖人数占比；撒哈拉以南非洲女性等地区存在例外，不能只归因某一种食物。

reviews.takeaway: 三项试验显示，母亲营养补充可提高乳汁B族维生素；婴儿生长改善只在营养不足更重的队列中观察到。

summary.problem: 母亲营养干预会不会让乳汁各类成分一起改变？
summary.method: 研究整合布基纳法索、巴基斯坦和坦桑尼亚三项随机试验的乳汁资料，比较平衡能量蛋白补充或烟酰胺干预与各自对照，并测量营养成分、菌群及组学指标。
summary.findings: B族维生素升高，宏量营养素、低聚糖等相对受生理缓冲。产后能量蛋白补充只在营养不足更重的队列改善婴儿生长。
summary.statistics: 摘要未报告总样本数和数值效应量，不自行补填。
summary.limitations: 不同干预、营养背景和结果指标不能混为一谈；不能推导所有哺乳者都需自行补充同一种营养品。
summary.meaning: 干预对不同成分及不同人群的作用可能不同。

reviews.stage: 人群纵向观察加类器官与小鼠实验
reviews.takeaway: 171名成人的接种后发热风险与接种前肠道炎症和菌群特征相关；实验支持部分机制，但尚非人体饮食干预证据。

summary.problem: 同样接种疫苗，为什么有人更容易发热？
summary.method: 研究纵向测量171名健康成人接种mRNA疫苗前后的粪便菌群、口腔温度和血清指标；另将高风险供者菌群用于人肠道类器官及无菌小鼠实验。
summary.findings: 接种前低度炎症、部分带鞭毛细菌及鞭毛蛋白表达与发热风险相关；供者菌群在实验系统中产生更强炎症，饮食可改变小鼠相关反应。
summary.statistics: 人体样本171人；摘要未给出可用于个人预测的绝对风险或干预效应量。
summary.limitations: 人体饮食为自报关联，小鼠干预不能直接证明人改变饮食就能避免发热，也不支持个人接种决策。
summary.meaning: 人群关联与实验机制证据应分层解读。

reviews.title: 鸟鸣像人类言语的声学模式，未必依赖发声学习
reviews.originalTitle: Pervasive patterns in bird songs resemble those in human speech and song and are independent of vocal learning
reviews.authorsNote: 仅列第一位个人署名作者，非完整名单。
reviews.publicationDateNote: 已核Crossref正式发表日；仅已核印刷日，在线首发日未知。
reviews.takeaway: 在大规模语料中，会与不会发声学习的鸟类都出现类似人类言语或歌唱的声学模式；相似声音不能单独证明相同学习机制。

summary.problem: 鸟鸣与人声的相似性，是否主要来自模仿学习？
summary.method: 研究比较367种鸟的逾7.45万个发声单元、约5900首鸟鸣，以及52种人类语言的逾1.5万个单元；同时比较发声学习类群和近缘非学习类群。
summary.findings: 多种声学模式跨鸟类类群出现，并与人类言语或歌唱相似；是否具有发声学习能力，没有系统改变这些模式和相似度。
summary.statistics: 367种鸟、52种语言；发声单元数量不是独立人类或动物个体数。
summary.limitations: 这是比较语料分析，不能仅由声音相似证明同一认知机制，也不能断言每种鸟都完全不需要学习。
summary.meaning: 表面相似与产生它的机制是两个问题。

message.abstract: <jats:p>Human milk (HM) composition is variable to support changing infant needs and is influenced by maternal diet and health. We harmonized HM data from three randomized trials in Burkina Faso (MISAME-III), Pakistan (Mumta-LW), and Tanzania (ELICIT) within the International Milk Composition (IMiC) Consortium to test how maternal nutrition affects HM composition. Balanced energy-protein (BEP) supplements or nicotinamide given to lactating mothers increased milk B-vitamins, while macronutrients, oligosaccharides, bioactive proteins, and microbiome composition were physiologically buffered. Metabolomic and proteomic analyses revealed shifts in vitamin-related metabolites, triglyceride profiles, and intracellular protein representation. In a MISAME-III subset, maternal and infant blood showed concordant changes. Postnatal BEP improved infant growth only in the more undernourished cohort. Improved milk micronutrient quality across settings supports extending maternal supplementation into lactation.</jats:p>
title: Nutritional interventions’ impacts on human milk: Three trials in low-resource settings

message.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Fever is a common adverse reaction to vaccination, contributing to vaccine hesitancy and reduced uptake. To understand variation in fever risk, we longitudinally profiled fecal microbiota, oral temperature, and serological markers in 171 healthy adults receiving Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 mRNA vaccines. Fever risk correlated with low-grade intestinal inflammation, increased abundance of flagellated
                    <jats:italic toggle="yes">Lachnospiraceae</jats:italic>
                    bacteria, and increased flagellin expression prevaccine. Microbiomes from fever-high donors triggered stronger inflammation in human intestinal organoids and drove flagellin-dependent vaccine reactions in gnotobiotic mice. Moreover, microbiome flagellin phenotypes and murine vaccine reactions were modifiable by diet. Consistent with this, human fever risk was associated with self-reported diet and metabolic markers. These findings identify the gut microbiome as a driver of vaccine-induced fever, suggesting that microbiome-targeting strategies could modulate immune tone and improve vaccine side effects.
                  </jats:p>
title: The human gut microbiome primes fever after vaccination

message.abstract: <jats:p>Bird songs are often described as analogs to human speech and songs, but expansive comparisons are necessary to determine analogy and mechanistic substrates. By analyzing global corpora consisting of 367 bird species (>74,500 vocal elements from ~5900 songs) within two clades of vocal learners (oscines and hummingbirds) and related nonlearners (suboscines and nightjars) and 52 human languages (>15,000 elements in >800 speech or song phrases), we revealed common patterns in bird songs that resemble prevalent patterns in human speech and song with variation in resemblance to speech or song. Vocal learning did not systematically affect acoustic patterning or similarity to human vocalizations. These data underscore the deep analogies between bird and human vocalizations and convergent motor mechanisms shaping communication.</jats:p>
title: Pervasive patterns in bird songs resemble those in human speech and song and are independent of vocal learning

message.abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>Social capital—the strength of an individual’s social network and community—has been identified as a potential determinant of outcomes ranging from education to health<jats:sup>1–8</jats:sup>. However, efforts to understand what types of social capital matter for these outcomes have been hindered by a lack of social network data. Here, in the first of a pair of papers<jats:sup>9</jats:sup>, we use data on 21 billion friendships from Facebook to study social capital. We measure and analyse three types of social capital by ZIP (postal) code in the United States: (1) connectedness between different types of people, such as those with low versus high socioeconomic status (SES); (2) social cohesion, such as the extent of cliques in friendship networks; and (3) civic engagement, such as rates of volunteering. These measures vary substantially across areas, but are not highly correlated with each other. We demonstrate the importance of distinguishing these forms of social capital by analysing their associations with economic mobility across areas. The share of high-SES friends among individuals with low SES—which we term economic connectedness—is among the strongest predictors of upward income mobility identified to date<jats:sup>10,11</jats:sup>. Other social capital measures are not strongly associated with economic mobility. If children with low-SES parents were to grow up in counties with economic connectedness comparable to that of the average child with high-SES parents, their incomes in adulthood would increase by 20% on average. Differences in economic connectedness can explain well-known relationships between upward income mobility and racial segregation, poverty rates, and inequality<jats:sup>12–14</jats:sup>. To support further research and policy interventions, we publicly release privacy-protected statistics on social capital by ZIP code at <jats:ext-link xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" ext-link-type="uri" xlink:href="https://www.socialcapital.org">https://www.socialcapital.org</jats:ext-link>.</jats:p>
title: Social capital I: measurement and associations with economic mobility

message.abstract:
<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>
                    Body-mass index (BMI) has increased steadily in most countries in parallel with a rise in the proportion of the population who live in cities
                    <jats:sup>1,2</jats:sup>
                    . This has led to a widely reported view that urbanization is one of the most important drivers of the global rise in obesity
                    <jats:sup>3–6</jats:sup>
                    . Here we use 2,009 population-based studies, with measurements of height and weight in more than 112 million adults, to report national, regional and global trends in mean BMI segregated by place of residence (a rural or urban area) from 1985 to 2017. We show that, contrary to the dominant paradigm, more than 55% of the global rise in mean BMI from 1985 to 2017—and more than 80% in some low- and middle-income regions—was due to increases in BMI in rural areas. This large contribution stems from the fact that, with the exception of women in sub-Saharan Africa, BMI is increasing at the same rate or faster in rural areas than in cities in low- and middle-income regions. These trends have in turn resulted in a closing—and in some countries reversal—of the gap in BMI between urban and rural areas in low- and middle-income countries, especially for women. In high-income and industrialized countries, we noted a persistently higher rural BMI, especially for women. There is an urgent need for an integrated approach to rural nutrition that enhances financial and physical access to healthy foods, to avoid replacing the rural undernutrition disadvantage in poor countries with a more general malnutrition disadvantage that entails excessive consumption of low-quality calories.
                  </jats:p>
title: Rising rural body-mass index is the main driver of the global obesity epidemic in adults
